evidence.explanation: The worker weighs distinct courses of action under ambiguity and resolves a novel, non-routine conflict between simulated and real events.

evidence.quote: Split the buses evenly across all three sites, or prioritize the site with the fastest-closing road first. I went with prioritizing that site.

evidence.quote: I could've tried to run the exercise debrief and real command informally side by side, or fully suspend the exercise and hand off command properly. I suspended it and gave the IC a written status briefing instead.
